exposure: Recommended GWG (11.5-16 kg) vs. excessive GWG (>16 kg)
outcome: Insulin-like growth factor binding protein 3 levels
cohort: Women without obesity (BMI <30 kg/m2) with a healthy singleton pregnancy undergoing elective Cesarean section at term
finding: Women with excessive gestational weight gain had significantly higher leptin levels and a trend towards lower prolactin levels at delivery compared to women with recommended weight gain, while other circulating hormones were not different between groups.
cross-section timing: At the time of delivery by elective Caesarean section
